name: video_concatenate
description: Concatenate completed video creations into one MP4. Assembles multi-clip plans from `video_plan`. Audio from each clip; no external audio bed. Returns queued creation.

name.description: Label for the concatenated video in the media viewer.

creationIdentifiers.description: 2-10 completed video identifiers in playback order.

folderReference.description: Optional project/folder reference from `folders_list` to place results in. Omit for the default.
